data.one_liner: Provides parsing, inspection, and readable formatting of Dart stack traces.
data.what_it_does: The package can convert native StackTrace objects into Trace objects, format them into human‑readable strings, and capture asynchronous stack chains. It also offers utilities like terse formatting to collapse core library frames.
use_when: You need clearer error logs during development or production debugging
You want to track asynchronous call stacks across zones
You need to format stack traces for reporting or logging
avoid_when: You only need simple stack traces and want to avoid extra dependencies
Your app size constraints are extremely tight and you cannot afford any extra package
weaknesses: Adds runtime overhead when capturing chains
Limited to stack‑trace manipulation; not a full logging solution

alternatives.name: logging
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides general logging facilities but lacks stack‑trace parsing and chain features
